name: Compute Void Ratio (NumPy)
definition: Calculates the void ratio (volume of empty space / volume of solid) for each voxel in a point cloud, handling boundary adjustments and smoothing.
summary: Compute Void Ratio (NumPy) calculates precise geometric void ratios for point clouds using vectorized NumPy operations, differing from plain Python by performance and from rendering methods by focusing on exact volume accounting.
